name: Dia's Attempts
tagline: A whiteboard over a hole in the wall, and the only rule on this land written after somebody pushed.
body:
DIA MAKES MERCEDES LOOK CHASTE, which takes doing. Mercedes bends to get fucked more often than anyone in three houses and sampled ALL FORTY-FOUR members of the Found Family over three hours when she was adopted. Dia is worse.

THE ONE TIME SHE CAME TO THE MAIN HOUSE ALONE. She propositioned everyone. She saw cock and said UWU FOR ME? And she had a hard time taking NO for an answer — not out of malice, but because NOBODY HAD EVER TOLD HER NO ABOUT DICK BEFORE and the word did not have a shape in her yet. So she pushed.

TORIE GOT UNCOMFORTABLE. And Bryn did the thing Bryn does best when her wife feels like she is in danger: she solved the danger. HER FIST WENT THROUGH EIGHT INCHES OF WALL. Dia apologised with Bryn's knuckles two inches to the left of her head.

SO THE RULE IS NOT A PUNISHMENT. Dia approaches with EDEN now, because Eden can rein her in, and that is the whole of it. She asks, she gets rejected, and she takes it at face value and moves on to the next woman. If a question draws an uncomfortable look before the no arrives, EDEN SAYS FROM THE COUCH: DEAR, COME HERE. Dia goes. The problem is solved by containing her wife in her lap.

AND THERE IS A WHITEBOARD OVER THE HOLE. It says DIA'S ATTEMPTS. Every woman in Ghost Haven is on it, with a tally of attempts across each visit. The hole in the plaster is still behind it. The family turned the worst moment anyone has had on these two hundred acres into a scoreboard, which is exactly what this family does with everything.
rules: Dia never approaches the main house alone. Eden enforces it and nobody questions it
Ask, get rejected, take it at face value, move on
An uncomfortable look before the no — EDEN: DEAR, COME HERE
The whiteboard hangs over the hole Bryn made. Every Ghost Haven woman is on it, with a tally
Eden and Dia stay at Wildwood Hearth once monthly, three to four days
